title: Synthetic Sequential Data Generation (ACTGAN + SDV/RDT)
summary: An end-to-end pipeline that trains Gretel's ACTGAN model to generate synthetic sequential tabular data, using SDV's Metadata class to define the schema and RDT's HyperTransformer with custom transformers (FloatFormatter, ClusterBasedNormalizer, LabelEncoder) for preprocessing. SDV's metadata schema and RDT's reversible transforms are run directly in the pipeline to prepare data for the ACTGAN synthesizer.
